description:
Search the 50heads help center (search), send feedback or a problem to support (feedback), check whether 50heads is working and whether asking is paused (status), or see who this connection acts as, with its scopes, caps and rate limits (whoami). Call whoami first when something is refused, and status when calls fail. search, feedback and status need no sign-in; whoami reads the account.

Pass action: one of search, feedback, status, whoami. Each action takes only its own arguments.
- search: Searches the 50heads help center (asking, results, credits and billing, verification, the API and MCP) and returns the best articles with links. Use it to answer a person's question about how 50heads works. No sign-in needed. Arguments: query (required), locale, limit. Read-only; no sign-in needed.
- feedback: Sends feedback or a problem to 50heads support as a ticket; a person replies by email. Use it when something about 50heads or this server did not work, or to suggest something. Signed in, the reply goes to the account's email; otherwise add email. Arguments: message (required), subject, kind, email. Changes something; no sign-in needed.
- status: Whether 50heads is working right now, and whether asking, answering, MCP asking or buying credits is paused. Check it when calls fail or results stop filling, and do not ask while asking is paused (nothing is charged while paused). No sign-in; costs nothing. No other arguments. Read-only; no sign-in needed.
- whoami: Who this connection acts as (a person or a service account, email masked), its scopes, its daily and per-question caps and today's spend, the account it spends from (personal or a team, with the role there), the organization where one is switched on, and the rate limits with what is used now. Call it first when something is refused, or before a large batch. Read-only; costs nothing. No other arguments. Read-only; needs account:read.
